framework.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0 & NIST AI 600-1 GenAI Profile)
framework.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
framework.description: NIST AI RMF 1.0 core functions (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE) and NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile risk controls.

controls.title: GOVERN 1.1: Legal, Regulatory and Security Policy Alignment
controls.description: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI security, data privacy, and scope authorization are understood, managed, and documented across the organization.

controls.title: GOVERN 1.2: Trustworthy AI Characteristics Integration
controls.description: Processes and organizational policies integrate trustworthy, secure, and resilient GenAI operational boundaries into system engineering standards.

controls.title: MAP 2.3: Scientific Integrity, Operational Boundaries and Threat Mapping
controls.description: Scientific integrity and architectural trust boundaries (prompt hierarchy, retrieval context, downstream sinks, and agent tool routers) are mapped and validated.

controls.title: MAP 4.1: Third-Party Data, RAG Corpus and Tool Risk Mapping
controls.description: Approaches for mapping security and intellectual property risks of external context documents, RAG vector stores, and connected agent tools are in place.

controls.title: MEASURE 2.5: AI System Validity, Reliability and Guardrail Verification
controls.description: The AI system to be deployed is demonstrated to be valid, reliable, and bounded via deterministic testing of input/output guardrails and configuration parameters.

controls.title: MEASURE 2.6: Safety, Resource Consumption and Failure Mode Evaluation
controls.description: AI system safety risks, unbounded token consumption ceilings, and recursive agent execution budgets are regularly evaluated and stress-tested.

controls.title: MEASURE 2.7: AI System Security and Adversarial Red-Teaming Resilience
controls.description: AI system security and resilience against direct/indirect prompt injection, meta-prompt extraction, RAG filter bypass, and agent goal hijacking are evaluated (NIST AI 600-1).

controls.title: MEASURE 2.10: Privacy Risk and Sensitive Data Leakage Examination
controls.description: Privacy risk of the GenAI system—including memorization, PII disclosure, credential exposure, and cross-tenant RAG leakage—is examined and documented.

controls.title: MANAGE 2.2: Mechanisms to Sustain Deployment Safety and Human Oversight
controls.description: Mechanisms are in place and applied to sustain the value of deployed AI systems, including Human-in-the-Loop approval gates, output sanitization, and tenant isolation.

controls.title: MANAGE 3.2: Pre-trained Models, Third-Party RAG and Tool Risk Monitoring
controls.description: Pre-trained models, vector stores, and external agent tools are monitored for configuration drift, anomalous invocations, and emerging vulnerabilities.
